''See also: [[Akura clan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Akura clan is a massive and immensely wealthy faction that holds significant influence over much of the continent, possessing resources that dwarf those of the [[Blackflame Empire]]. Known for their mastery of [[shadow madra]], they maintain a reputation for being formidable, intimidating, and occasionally ruthless. Their territory is characterized by imposing, dark fortresses like [[Moongrave]] and massive walls constructed from black [[Forged madra]]. The clan is composed of a powerful head family and various branch families, as well as numerous vassal states that must follow their [[Authority|authority]] to ensure their own survival. A defining tradition of the clan is naming its members after virtues. The leadership is anchored by powerful figures known as pillars, including the [[Monarch Malice]], the [[Sage of the Silver Heart]] ([[Charity]]), and the [[Herald]] [[Fury]]. The clan's strength is further bolstered by highly skilled combatants, such as [[Archlord|Archlords]] and [[Sages]], who utilize specialized bloodline legacies like unique armor. Members of the head family are often distinguished through trials involving sacred Books that test their abilities on specific [[Paths]]. While they have historically protected humanity from [[dragons]], the Akura clan is driven by its own interests and philosophies, often prioritizing the strength and continuity of the clan name above all else.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The Akura clan, which owns three-quarters of the continent, has spent generations shielding [[The Empire|the Empire]] from [[dragons]]. While they share a human identity with the [[Blackflame Empire]], they otherwise remain largely apathetic toward it. The clan employs the world's greatest [[dream artists]], utilizing dream-readers who can perceive the currents of destiny and shifts in [[Fate|fate]]. In addition to providing battle reports concerning encounters with [[Redmoon Hall]], the clan has made a formal request regarding an errant daughter and expressed that they do not entirely approve of [[Mercy]]'s presence.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The Akura clan is a group of various branches described as an empire of children that provides protection to the [[Skysworn]], even though the [[Skysworn]] view members like [[Akura Mercy]] as potentially dangerous liabilities. This entity, which possesses Akura Harmony{{!}}Harmony's armor as a bloodline legacy, rewards the acquisition of [[Underlord]] heads but prefers taking prisoners over honorable killing. While their power is dwarfed by [[Black dragons|black dragons]], the family deals with [[dragons]] and remains an entity that should not be opposed. Despite hiding a child's [[Fate|fate]] from the [[Monarch]], the clan faces dissolution alongside the breaking world and may participate in upcoming competitions.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The vaunted Akura clan is a [[Monarch]] faction within the [[Blackflame Empire]], possessing legendary pillars and a mountain-sized [[fortress]]. Famous for their use of [[shadow madra]], the family's favor can determine the survival of [[The Empire|the Empire]] and they hold responsibility for [[Renfei]]'s death. As a group that [[King Dakata]] serves, the clan maintains vassals who are forced to compete and holds [[Night Wheel Valley]] as a treasured territory. After providing a signal to [[Naru Huan|Emperor Naru Huan]], the clan becomes involved in a competition regarding the gate. [[Lindon]] eventually prepares to compete on behalf of the Akura clan, which owns the territory where his family resides.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Composed of members including a [[Monarch]] and a [[Fury]], the Akura clan is a family led by the daughter of [[Monarch Malice]]. While they prepare [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]] for the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]], [[Lindon]] remains a guest who was not raised with their specific training. The clan, which features the [[Frozen Blade school]] as a vassal faction and uses a symbol of a mountain range topped by three stars, is known for purifying [[madra]] to produce [[pure scale|pure scales]]. During the [[tournament]], the clan is ushered into the [[Ninecloud Court]] by servants in rainbow robes and faces targeting from [[Gold dragons|gold dragons]]. Although [[Eithan]] views the family as oppressors, [[Lindon]] intends to gather their competitors even after the second round of the competition splits the faction.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Residing in an amethyst spire within their assigned tower in [[Ninecloud City]], the purple-eyed Akura clan is a powerful faction that has raised a [[Herald]], a [[Sage]], and a [[Monarch]]. While they maintain alliances with [[Heralds]] and [[Sages]] and possess thousands of [[soulfire]] arts, the clan faces hostility from ocean [[inhabitants]] and has dealt with the loss of a rising star during conflicts involving [[Maraan]]. Despite periods of chaos and war, the clan remains capable of operating independently, even as they provide [[advancement]] resources to [[Yerin]] in hopes of winning [[Penance]]. The family, whose members are named after virtues and who maintain associations with [[Arelius family|House Arelius]], continues to manage their territory and settle matters through contribution points.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Akura clan, which is governed by a head family and based in their capital of [[Moongrave]], operates with three pillars and possesses both troops and [[Golds]]. While the clan is known for providing protection to people, they faced scrutiny when [[Lindon]] blamed them for failing to assist the [[inhabitants]] of [[Sacred Valley]] during an investigation. Despite having been reduced from three stars to two, the clan deployed a fleet of cloudships to the border of the [[Desolate Wilds]] for an evacuation effort. This fleet successfully transported refugees to the [[Heaven’s Glory School|Heaven's Glory School]], supported by a group of forty [[Golds]] who followed [[Lindon]].}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|After [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]] previously utilized the Akura clan's name, the clan declared [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] territory to be off-limits. [[Lindon]] maintained an agreement to contact them should [[Mercy]]'s life face any danger, and he was eventually honored before the clan. While [[Charity]] and [[Malice]] serve as pillars of the family, the [[Heart Sage]] took [[Mercy]] to assist in leading the clan. Now ruled by [[Queen]] [[Malice]], the [[Akura clan territory|Akura territory]] is home to [[Herald]]-level spirits that shine like bonfires. In the [[World of Night]], a statue of [[Mercy]] sits at the head of the clan.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Akura clan is a formidable power that can be antagonized, represented by banners featuring a purple-and-black aesthetic. Their influence is vast, with various [[Heralds]] and [[Sages]] owing them allegiance, and they possess enough experts to maintain control over [[Lindon]]. During the defense of [[Moongrave]], the clan mustered twelve [[Archlord|Archlords]] to protect the area. Members of the lineage include [[Akura Justice]] and [[Akura Malice]], who has spoken with the clan's [[Authority|authority]], while Akura Pride{{!}}Pride's mother sought to keep [[Mercy]] away from [[Lindon]] during his interactions with the clan.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|“We are here on behalf of the Blackflame Empire,” Renfei said loudly, “under the protection of the Akura family.”<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|“We have no grudge against the Akura clan.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|“We were very careful not to do anything that might weaken fellow servants of the Akura clan,” King Dakata assured her.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Instead,” the Sage continued, “you will compete on behalf of the great Akura clan.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“By the authority of the Akura clan, let it be known that the sacred artist formerly known as Wei Shi Lindon Arelius has been corrupted by the power of the Silent King,” she announced.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c24" />}}
